remarks: Introducing a condo rental opportunity at the sought-after Linden House. This spacious 1 bedroom is filled with natural light, boasting elegant hardwood floors throughout and recent renovations for a modern touch. Step into the welcoming ambiance of a spacious dining area opening to a large sunny living room, perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying leisurely moments. The complex has well-manicured grounds featuring mature flowering trees and shrubs that enchant in every season. Conveniently located in close proximity to Glenbrook station, commuting is a breeze. Rent includes heat, water, and a dedicated parking space. On-site amenities include laundry facilities and a assigned storage unit, with a Tot Lot available for family enjoyment. Explore Stamford Downtown's vibrant offerings or travel to New York City effortlessly via Metro North or car.
